sections.heading: We measure your kitchen before we build a thing.
sections.body:
A retrofit only works if the shelf fits the opening exactly, and no two kitchens are the same. So a designer measures each cabinet you want changed — the face frame, the hinge intrusion, the depth to the back — and every shelf is cut to that one opening in our own shop.

We do one trade and do it well. Your doors, counters and plumbing all stay put. Most kitchens are fitted in a single morning, and if a glide ever needs adjusting, the people who built it come back and set it right.

sections.heading: The rest of the house.
sections.intro: The same measured-and-built approach, in every other room.

items.question: Do you have to replace my cabinets?
items.answer: No. The shelves fit inside the base and wall cabinets you already have. Doors, counters and plumbing all stay where they are.

items.question: Will they fit an older or non-standard cabinet?
items.answer: Usually yes, and that is the point of measuring on site. Older cabinets are rarely square, so each shelf is cut for one specific opening.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Our standard glides are rated to **100 lb** per shelf, which covers stand mixers, stacked cast iron and full cases of tinned goods.

items.question: How long does a kitchen take to install?
items.answer: Most kitchens are done in a single morning. Larger jobs across several rooms can run to a full day, and we tell you which before you book.

items.question: What is the warranty?
items.answer: Lifetime on the glide hardware for as long as you own the home. Shelves themselves carry a five year warranty against defects.
